name: Issho ni Arukou.
source:
Ayumi has lost her important person. She joins the secret festival that takes part on the New Year's Eve.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
步失去了自己最重要的人。她参加了一场在除夕夜举行的秘密祭典。
